svg.title: The prompt step on a one-line request
svg.desc: You type "Let me compare any stock with the S&P 500 in my stock market research app", and 100x first writes a full prompt of about 880 words. An excerpt. Goal: both lines start at 0% on the first shared day. Rule: percent change from a shared start, not prices. Risk: a stock split shows up as a fake loss. Asks: 9, two of them tests that must fail first. Hard test: a two-for-one split shows 0% change. Do not: draw raw prices on a shared axis. Moment: type a ticker, both lines start at 0%. Judge: does a hand count across a split match?

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: /100x Let me compare any stock with the
S&P 500 in my stock market research app
